text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
It's a
period of intense training where
racers can
improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wow... ☆ What a cute red house!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So this is where we'll be spending our
grown-up
summer together!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: Our 'Summer Training Camp' together, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You could treat me like a kid just
this once
and play along!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, summer camp with Mayano
Top Gun
begins.
